question: Identify the top revenue-generating gas station that served customers who paid in EUR and belonged to the 'KAM' segment. For this gas station, also report how many more 'Discount' segment gas stations exist in the Czech Republic than in Slovakia.

WITH top_station AS (
    SELECT g.XCL_004
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'KAM'
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY g.XCL_004
    ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_018) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
discount_counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_006 = 'CZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cz_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_006 = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sk_count
    FROM gasstations
    WHERE XCL_007 = 'Discount'
)
SELECT
    ts.XCL_004,
    dc.cz_count - dc.sk_count AS discount_difference
FROM top_station ts
CROSS JOIN discount_counts dc

    SELECT g.XCL_004
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001

    ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_018) DESC

),
discount_counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_006 = 'CZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cz_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_006 = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sk_count
    FROM gasstations
    WHERE XCL_007 = 'Discount'
)
SELECT
    ts.XCL_004,
    dc.cz_count - dc.sk_count AS discount_difference
FROM top_station ts
CROSS JOIN discount_counts dc

WITH top_station AS (
    SELECT g.XCL_004
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'KAM'
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY g.XCL_004
    ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_018) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
discount_counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_006 = 'CZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cz_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_006 = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sk_count
    FROM gasstations
    WHERE XCL_007 = 'Discount'
)
SELECT
    ts.XCL_004,
    dc.cz_count - dc.sk_count AS discount_difference
FROM top_station ts
CROSS JOIN discount_counts dc

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE XCL_007 = 'Discount' AND XCL_006 = 'CZE') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE XCL_007 = 'Discount' AND XCL_006 = 'SVK') AS count_difference
FROM (SELECT g.XCL_004
      FROM customers c
      JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
      JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
      WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'KAM' AND c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
      GROUP BY g.XCL_004
      ORDER BY SUM(t.XCL_018) DESC
      LIMIT 1) AS top_station;
